thesis: The speaker argues that his interest in environmental sustainability was driven by witnessing the environmental degradation and health effects of coal dependence in his hometown in China, where coal was a rationed commodity essential for survival. He further explains that his focus on social issues was shaped by observing income inequality and social segmentation as a first-generation immigrant in the U.S., specifically recalling his transition from a free lunch recipient to someone who paid for his own meals.
